column3: The jobs inline wait (JOB_WAIT_MS, 8 s) became the jobs row's waitMs config, default 8000; TEST_PROFILE sets it to 1000, and vitest prebundles the pi and cordis packages with the SSR deps optimizer
column4: Instabox CI shards by file, so the slowest file is the long pole: jobs.test.ts spent 37 s in real 8 s waits and 20 s/9 s fixture sleeps, and every file paid about 5 s of per-module imports
column5: gate runs: jobs 40.0 s to 3.6 s, mcp 12.6 s to 5.3 s; import 55.8 s with the optimizer off vs 35.3 s with it on for the same 27 files
